task.description: Validate test spec and E2E file for OIDC-F-05/06. Hard gate.
acceptance_criteria: OIDC-F-05 and OIDC-F-06 MUST criteria each have a runnable test

result.summary: OIDC-F-05 covered by TC-OIDCF2-01/02 (real backend API). OIDC-F-06 covered by TC-OIDCF2-03/04. No test.skip. TC-OIDCF2-04 uses only allowed page.route mock. TC-OIDCF2-03 abort-intercepts Keycloak URL without synthesizing fake response (T-2 upheld). All 4 tests take screenshots per T-3.

issues.description: Spec T-2 text says only TC-OIDCF2-04 uses page.route but TC-OIDCF2-03 also uses page.route to abort Keycloak navigation. No fake auth response synthesized; T-2 not violated but text is inaccurate.
